title: Learned phase models identify synergistic photoanode mixtures
summary: Learning from measured diffraction and photocurrent data identified Bi-Cu-V oxide phase mixtures whose photoactivity exceeded an additive non-interacting-phase model. BiVO4-like phases showed beneficial associations with copper-vanadate phases. This is an experimentally grounded composition-property result; the underlying electronic, catalytic and morphological mechanisms remain unresolved, and device-level solar-fuel efficiency was not established.
ai_technology: Deep Reasoning Networks and matrix factorization
organization: California Institute of Technology; Cornell University

evidence.tested: Measured photocurrents and phase distributions were compared with a learned additive baseline.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication, detailed mechanisms and practical device performance were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep Reasoning Networks and matrix factorization supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.
